pokedexEntries.bk: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

pokedexEntries.wh: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
